card.name: Punctuation after psychiatric treatment names
card.fires_on: Opening parentheses, 'and', or a space right after a psychiatric treatment name or before a duration number, in depression and mood-disorder text. It also fires on small linking words in treatment-outcome citations.

modes.label: Bracket after treatment name
modes.description: An opening parenthesis follows a named therapy or stimulation method, just before its abbreviation or citation.

modes.label: Space before duration number
modes.description: The space just before a number of months or weeks in trial-length statements.

modes.label: Linking word in therapy lists
modes.description: A joining word between treatment names or before treatment outcome.
